readme.title: README
readme.content:
timelessslatehen.org
This repository contains the source for timelessslatehen.org, a static site built with Quartz and published with GitHub Pages.
Repository layout

quartz/content/ — Markdown notes and other source content for the site. The home page is index.md.
quartz/quartz.config.yaml — site identity, URL, theme, plugins, and layout settings.
quartz/ — Quartz source, dependencies, and build configuration.
.github/workflows/deploy-quartz.yml — builds and deploys the site to GitHub Pages.

Writing content
Add or edit Markdown files under quartz/content/. Quartz supports standard Markdown, GitHub Flavored Markdown, and Obsidian-style links and formatting. A note can include frontmatter such as:
---
title: Example title
description: A short summary for previews
tags:
  - example
---
 
Write your note here.
Use draft: true in frontmatter to keep a draft out of the generated site. Content in this repository is part of its Git history, so do not add passwords, credentials, or material that must remain confidential.
Local development
Requirements: Node.js 22 or newer and npm 10.9.2 or newer.
cd quartz
npm ci
npm run quartz -- build --serve
Open the local URL printed by Quartz (port 8080 by default). The development server watches for changes and rebuilds the site. Stop it with Ctrl+C.
To create a production build without starting the server:
npm run quartz -- build --output public
The generated quartz/public/ directory is build output; make content and configuration changes in the source files instead.
Deployment
Push changes to main to publish them. The GitHub Actions workflow runs when files under quartz/ or the deployment workflow itself change, and can also be started manually from the repository’s Actions tab. It installs the locked npm dependencies, builds Quartz, and deploys the generated site to GitHub Pages.
GitHub Pages should be configured to use GitHub Actions as its build and deployment source. The site domain is set in quartz/quartz.config.yaml; update it there if the domain changes.

index.title: Welcome to the Garden
index.content:
Jack’s Digital Garden
A growing repository of evolving thoughts, creative writing, game theory research, and programming experiments.

Garden Key:
🌱 Seedling: Raw ideas, quick snippets, and quotes.
🌿 Budding: Outlined concepts, working prototypes, and developing drafts.
🌲 Evergreen: Settled mechanics, comprehensive guides, and mature reference notes.


🗺️ Areas of Focus
✍️ Writing & Craft

Fiction drafting, worldbuilding bibles, and EPUB export formatting.
Technical documentation, architecture notes, and narrative analysis.

🎲 Game Design & Theory

Decision spaces, payoff matrices, and player agency.
Interactive storytelling, branching dialogue, and environmental narrative design.

💻 Programming

Python logic prototypes, scripting utilities, and backend tools.
Explorations into lightweight game engines and new languages.

🛠️ Projects & Devlogs

Active builds, game design documents (GDDs), and experiment logs.
